note: A built MDC camp, unusual for an access: ten gravel pads with picnic tables along a shaded spur that ends in a turnaround loop, with a privy at the entrance. The East Fork of the Grand River is 80 to 100 m north through the woods; a short track leads to it. --Claude
summary: Confirmed a real campground, not lot camping: the page says '10 gravel camping pads with picnic tables', the map draws a CAMPING AREA spur with pad stubs, a turnaround and a privy. Count 10 and vault toilet written. Pin on the camp. Phone matches. Not waterfront stands.
flags: DISTINCT CAMP: page text 'This area offers access to the East Fork of the Grand River and 10 gravel camping pads with picnic tables.'; Things To Do lists 'Individual Campsites'. The 09/09 map labels a CAMPING AREA: a gravel spur west of the parking lot with pad stubs on its north side, ending in a loop, and a Privy symbol beside the lot. GIS layer 27 has 5 points strung along that spur (40.38859,-94.32189 to 40.38833,-94.32298); the page's 10 is written as the count (the GIS points look like one per pair of pads). On imagery the spur and the 30 m turnaround loop are visible; the pads themselves are under canopy.

WATERFRONT (no change, not waterfront): the camp spur is 80-100 m south of the East Fork Grand River with unbroken woods between (leaf-on frame); no pad within 50 m and no open ground toward the river. The river access is a separate track north from the entrance fork.
PIN: stored 40.38859,-94.32189 is the easternmost GIS camping point, at the head of the camp spur. On the camp; no move (the middle of the row is 40.38845,-94.32247, 50 m west).

ACCESS: gravel Quarry Avenue from Denver to the entrance; no posted limit, ford or 4WD wording on the page, brochure or map. Site length unpublished; pads sit beside a through spur with a loop to turn in.
PHONE: stored 660-646-6122 matches the page's 'For more information call (660) 646-6122'.

Brochure: 'No open fires, except in designated areas' and 'Camping is permitted in designated areas and is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30day period'. Stored year_round (manual) stands; no closure posted.
